failure_summary.description: ROSIE alternative is listed in Branches but no code path; users default to GigaTIME without considering the lighter ROSIE

edits.content:
### Lighter path: ROSIE (tile-level)

When compute is tight, ROSIE generates per-tile mean expression instead
of pixel-level channels:

```python
import lazyslide as zs
zs.pp.tile_tissues(wsi, 256, stride_px=32)
zs.tl.virtual_stain(wsi, model="rosie")              # writes wsi.images["rosie_prediction"]
rosie = wsi.images["rosie_prediction"]
print(rosie.c.data)                                   # biomarker channel names
print(rosie.shape)                                    # (C, n_tiles)
```

ROSIE outputs are ~50x smaller than GigaTIME at the cost of resolution
(tile-level vs pixel-level). For per-cell quantification downstream,
GigaTIME is required.
